column1: # Season relief allowance of each site, in energy ticks; one row per site_id of sites.csv.
# The allowance of a site is drawn by the events of the season, which reach it one at a time in the
# order of the instants at which they start (dispatch_start in events.json), events that start at the
# same instant following the programme conventions. When an event is reached, what remains of a
# site's allowance is its allowance_ticks less the relief ticks, over all intervals, of the site's
# offers chosen in the events reached before it. An offer whose relief ticks over all intervals are
# more than what remains of its site's allowance when its event is reached is not a candidate offer.
